label: No self-giving of being from no efficient self-causation, via a self-edge bridge
summary: Target: the strict no-self-giving premise 0e473dc4 (NoSelfGivingOnAccessible) of the nonexternal causal Arrival B route (result 9e5124a2, attempt 9d141c6c), toward e4a3b917, b19ffd92 and STMT-GOD-EXISTS. Horizontal support from the Second Way family. Spec: specs/concurrent-giving-priority-bridge.toml; PR #1863, stacked on #1856. REGISTERED (indexed) ROUTE, after the semantic re-check on #1863. Efficient causation is a supplied relation EfficientlyCausesAt v t c x r indexed by history and moment (definition 1d8c68c3): for each fixed v and t it is the here-and-now efficient causing of EFFICIENT_CAUSING_2 (69c0b23e) read in that history at that moment. (1) Result a59169d5 (argument 265cc74a, noSelfGivingFromIndexedNoSelfCause): the OPEN indexed self-edge bridge ca5d4eaa (in every accessible v at every t, GivesAt v c c t implies EfficientlyCausesAt v t c c esse) and the OPEN indexed no-self premise 872ff8b6 (in no accessible history at no moment is anything its own efficient cause) give 0e473dc4. No index is dropped, so nothing is moved between histories or moments. (2) Result 9ed661bd (argument 9c974b88, indexedNoSelfCauseFromPriority): the OPEN indexed cause-priority premise b402ca7b and nothing-prior-to-itself 32d77f18, through the verified SelfCausationPriority.noSelfCauseFromPriority applied in each history at each moment with the single unindexed PriorSimply (PRIOR_1, 1d9aa4d9), give 872ff8b6. (3) indexedControls: in MetricBeginningArrival.Control.selfGivingFrame with empty indexed efficient causation and empty PriorSimply, b402ca7b, 32d77f18 and 872ff8b6 hold while the bridge and 0e473dc4 fail; a logical omission control. 872ff8b6 and b402ca7b are analyst statements with attribution deferred: the Aquinas claims on the selected-time 8b2561cd and e078f07b do not extend to them; the 'nec est possibile' of ST I q.2 a.3 is an unchecked candidate basis for 872ff8b6. WITHDRAWN ROUTE AND REASON. The first version registered an index-free bridge 0e961fde (SelfGivingIsEfficientSelfCause: GivesAt v c c t implies EfficientlyCausesIn c c esse, any history, any moment) with two arguments: 3b57de88/caed414d (0e961fde + 8b2561cd) and ae6a8763/15e3a176 (0e961fde + e078f07b + 32d77f18). The bridge dropped the history and moment indices, so both arguments needed 8b2561cd and e078f07b under a world- and time-neutral reading, while the corpus fixes 8b2561cd as the selected-time version (relation 3a61a9fb: d15ded6f strengthens 8b2561cd; result 8e634495's past-self control; disambiguation 57f80020) and their definition link 69c0b23e is here-and-now. Support of 8b2561cd (for example argument 0f804637 from the single-world all-times d15ded6f) would have been counted for a premise used more strongly, and the Aquinas claim b51ad80f would have stayed bound. Those statement, definition (647b3d0a), argument, inference and result records were removed before merge; the Lean declarations SelfGivingIsEfficientSelfCause, noSelfGivingFromNoSelfCause, noSelfGivingFromEfficientPriority and controls stay in the frozen Challenge and Solution, marked superseded and unregistered. REJECTED APPROACHES. Restricting the index-free bridge to accessible histories: the consequent stays index-free. A world- and time-neutral efficient-causing sense: it would make the reused selected-time premises equivocal and needs sense bridges with no available premise. Reusing DistinctActualEsseCauseIsEfficient (8934912c): it covers only causes distinct from their effect and starts from CausesIn, not GivesAt. No strengthens relation from 872ff8b6 to 8b2561cd is registered: 8b2561cd is stated over an unindexed relation, so a strong-to-weak result needs a further premise (an accessible actual history and a selected moment) and would not have the strong version as its only premise. OBJECTION AUDIT: no substantive objection identified to the indexed bridge or premises; all remain OPEN. Given #1856's equivalence (under 0e473dc4 and d3184c66 the nonexternal premise 2a4d99d8 is equivalent to e4a3b917), supporting 0e473dc4 does not discriminate against a rival who denies that a necessary concretum is possible. No premise is established.
blocker: OPEN: warrant for the indexed self-edge bridge ca5d4eaa (strict self-giving of being in a history at a moment would be efficient self-causation there and then) and for the all-histories, all-moments Second Way premises 872ff8b6 and b402ca7b. Next tests: read ST I q.2 a.3 ('nec est possibile') in the pinned passage to decide whether a modal no-self-causation claim can be attributed (then a claim on 872ff8b6); register a strength comparison relating 872ff8b6 to 8b2561cd with the needed premises made explicit (the selected world accessible from itself, and 8b2561cd's unindexed relation read as EfficientlyCausesAt at the selected world and a selected moment); a comparison with the all-admitted-times d15ded6f would further need a correspondence between its time-indexed relation and EfficientlyCausesAt at the selected world for every admitted time.
